Diving Gale Strike.name: Diving Gale Strike
Diving Gale Strike.description: The user's signature move: they climb on a wing-made updraft, fold their wings and dive in a roaring cone of compressed air that strikes a target and bursts across half a street. It deals massive slashing and force damage and hurls enemies off their feet; held back, the cone breaks early and only flattens them. Firing both natures at full force strips feathers and grounds the user until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.
